extracted_rows.q: Why don't you ride the donkey? It's strong, put the boy on it!
extracted_rows.a: What a good idea! Son, jump on the donkey.

extracted_rows.q: Why's your son riding the donkey? He's young, make him walk!
extracted_rows.a: Please don't shout! But I agree with you. Come on son, jump down, let's take turns.

extracted_rows.q: Hey, look at your son. He's very tired. He should ride the donkey!
extracted_rows.a: Oh dear … She's right, come on son, it's your turn.

extracted_rows.q: Mum, why don't they both ride the donkey?
extracted_rows.a: You're right. Move up son, I'm getting on.

extracted_rows.q: Poor donkey! I can see clearly it is very tired.
extracted_rows.a: Yes, our donkey has carried us for a long time! It's OUR turn to carry HIM now, son.
